tier2_explanatory.short_meaning: Captive; subdued; subservient (for the spelling عانية)
tier2_explanatory.long_meaning: The spelling عانية (ʿāniya) is the active participle of the Arabic root ع-ن-و (ʿ-n-w), 'to be subdued, to submit'. The different spelling آنية (āniya) is a separate word meaning 'vessel, container'. The two spellings must not be merged. Its root is ع-ن-و (ʿ-n-w). Aaniya is a Arabic name meaning “Captive; subdued; subservient (for the spelling عانية)”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
